id: title:Gilbert09:accept an api url entered without a scheme

observations.behavior: Adds HTTPS prefix to bare host URLs before warehouse ingestion.
observations.posthog_connection: Makes the ActiveCampaign connector more forgiving of user input while preserving protocol; could prevent silent failures if users omit scheme.

observations.behavior: Adds tests for bare-host and HTTP inputs in normalize_base_url.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that normalization behavior is preserved or documented rather than silently changing semantics.

observations.behavior: Changes credential validation error message with a copy-paste instruction and retains https-only check.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies expected URL format without removing existing SSRF protection; does not change tier-3 systemic risk reduction.
